generateGreatCircle calculates d as spherical angular distance, but when start and end coordinates are antipodal (d = PI radians, where Math.sin(d) ≈ 0) or contain invalid coordinates, Math.sin(d) evaluates to 0 causing division by zero and resulting in NaN coordinate injection in Map layers.

handleDownloadPDF forwards user-controlled trip titles and activity memos to PDF generator without sanitization, creating an opportunity for unhandled exceptions or memory bloat during html2canvas rendering.

getTripSnapshotSync reads from localStorage and updates L1 RAM cache, but concurrent writes during key migration (tabidachi_ to tabiji_) could lead to unhandled JSON parse exceptions or stale state desynchronization.

Binding Tabiji brand tokens (#F6F5EE background and #1E2927 text) to root CSS variables without tuning muted-foreground (#7D8B88) creates contrast ratios falling below WCAG 2.1 AA standards or breaking Radix UI dialog visibility in dark mode.
